items.name: EmptyState

items.name: searchRows

items.name: sortRows
items.purpose: Stable sorted copy: en-IN numeric-aware collation for strings, numbers numerically, Dates and ISO date strings chronologically, empty values last. Accepts a DataTable SortState or a SortMenu value.

items.name: paginate
items.purpose: Rows of a 1-based page, clamped to the valid range. Pair with TableFooter (and pageCount for the page count).
